qs.e: HTML tags are not case-sensitive: `<HTML>`, `<Html>` and `<html>` are treated as the same tag (the lecture examples even mix upper- and lower-case tags). So tags are neither required to be upper case only, nor lower case only, nor case-sensitive.

qs.q: What should be the first tag in any HTML document?
qs.e: The skeleton of an HTML document starts with `<html>` and ends with `</html>`. Inside it come the `<head>` section (heading information such as the title) and the `<body>` section (the actual page content). `<document>` is not an HTML tag.

qs.q: Tags and text that are not directly displayed on the page are written in the ______ section.
qs.e: The `<head>` section (called the Heading Section in the lecture skeleton) holds information about the page, such as its `<title>`, which appears in the browser title bar and not in the page content. Everything displayed in the browser window is written inside `<body>`. `<html>` is the root element that contains both, and `<title>` is only one element inside the head.

qs.q: The `<title>` ... `</title>` tag must be placed within:
qs.e: In the HTML skeleton the page title is written inside the `<head>` section, as in the lecture example: `<head><title>Title bar text</title></head>`. It is not written inside the body, a form, a table or a script.

qs.q: Which tag is used to insert a line break (blank line) in an HTML page?

qs.q: Which HTML tag is used to display a power, as in (A+B)<sup>2</sup>?
qs.e: `<sup>` produces superscript text (raised above the baseline), as in 31<sup>st</sup> or (A+B)<sup>2</sup>. `<sub>` produces subscript (lowered), as in H<sub>2</sub>O. `<script>` and `<style>` are not text-formatting tags.
The `<em>` (emphasis) element renders text in italic, exactly like `<i>`. Bold is produced by `<b>` or `<strong>`. `<em>` has nothing to do with lists or indentation.

qs.q: Apart from the `<b>` tag, which other tag makes text bold?
qs.e: `<strong>` is the alternative to `<b>` for bold text, just as `<em>` is the alternative to `<i>` for italic. `<fat>`, `<black>` and `<emp>` are not valid HTML tags.

qs.q: Which of the following is not a paired tag (it has no closing tag)?
qs.e:
HTML has container tags, which come as a pair (opening and closing tag), and empty tags, which have no content and no closing tag. `` is an empty tag, while `

qs.q: Which is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
qs.e: An HTML comment starts with `<!--` and ends with `-->`; anything between them is not displayed by the browser. The other syntaxes are not recognized by HTML.

qs.q: Which HTML tag produces the biggest heading?
qs.e: Heading levels run from `<h1>` to `<h6>`, and the number is inverse to the text size: `<h1>` is the largest and `<h6>` is the smallest.

qs.q: The World Wide Web (WWW) is based on which model?
qs.e: The web works on the client-server model: the client computer runs a web browser and sends requests over the Internet, and the server computer (web server and database management system) responds. This is the structure of a web application shown in the lecture.
